source_scope: Linux stable v6.12.107; Debian/platform patch equivalence still requires review
source_findings: H27UCG8T2ETR-BC enables scrambling and dist3 pairing with two groups
Physical eraseblock has 256 pages; marker page is 255
SLC group 0 has 128 pages: logical page 0 maps to physical 0; pages 1 through 127 map to 2*page-1
Final SLC page maps to physical 253 and cannot directly expose marker page 255
Default flash BBT reserves the final scan range; reserved status does not establish a physical bad marker, and marker presence does not identify factory/runtime origin
